collection.title: BMW 1 Series Convertible 2008 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 1 Series Convertible 2008 to 2013 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
